Action Input: {"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/react/quenching/brief/subtasks/magnesium_npt_relaxation_subtask_quenching_trial_4/in.mg_npt", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for Mg NPT relaxation

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Create Mg HCP lattice
lattice hcp 3.21
region box block 0 5 0 5 0 5
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/react/quenching/brief/subtasks/magnesium_potential_file_subtask_quenching_trial_4/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

# Initialize velocities
velocity all create 300 12345

# Define compute for density
compute density all property/atom mass
compute avg_density all reduce sum c_density
variable vol equal vol
variable density equal c_avg_density/${vol}*1.6605402

# Timestep
timestep 1.0

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-6 1.0e-8 1000 10000

# NPT relaxation
fix 1 all npt temp 300 300 100 iso 0 0 1000
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press vol density

# Run NPT
run 10000

# Write final structure and density
variable dens equal v_density
print "Final density = ${dens}" file density.txt
write_data relaxed.data"}
